title: Annual multistate histories of 369 branded female Steller sea lions seen with a pup at five southeastern Alaska rookeries, 2001-2015 (natal and breeding philopatry)
creator: Hastings, Kelly K.; Jemison, Lauri A.; Pendleton, Grey W.; Raum-Suryan, Kimberly L.; Pitcher, Kenneth W.
citation: Hastings, K. K., Jemison, L. A., Pendleton, G. W., Raum-Suryan, K. L. & Pitcher, K. W. (2018). Data from: Natal and breeding philopatry of female Steller sea lions in southeastern Alaska [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.48j0m
abstract: Female Steller sea lions branded as pups at southeastern Alaska rookeries were resighted each breeding season (May-July); a female definitively seen with a pup in a year is coded by where she was seen. The authors fitted multistate mark-recapture models in which the first release is an artificial sighting at the natal location in the year before a female's first pup, so that the first transition estimates natal philopatry and later transitions breeding philopatry.
samplingProtocol: Resighting of branded females from land and boat surveys of rookeries, May-July each year; a female's sightings definitively with a pup (birth, nursing and similar behaviour) in a year are pooled to one annual record of where she pupped.

stateCodes.0: not seen with a pup that year
stateCodes.1: with a pup at F, Forrester Island Complex (letter F)
stateCodes.2: with a pup at H, Hazy Islands (letter H)
stateCodes.3: with a pup at B, Biali Rocks (letter Z)
stateCodes.4: with a pup at W, White Sisters (letter W)
stateCodes.5: with a pup at G, Graves Rocks (letter V)

closureNote: one pooled annual record per year
geographicCoverage: Southeastern Alaska rookeries: Forrester Island Complex, Hazy Islands, Biali Rocks, White Sisters, Graves Rocks (no coordinates deposited)
covariateNote: unit_birth_year: year of birth and branding. obs_release: 1 on the authors' artificial natal sighting in the year before a female's first pup (not an observation), else 0. y_raw: the deposited letter.

notShipped.within_year: individual sightings within a year (pooled by the authors; not deposited)

notes: Unit ids are line numbers (no brand ids in the deposit). Rows begin at the study's first year or the birth year if later (E4.4); the row with obs_release = 1 is the authors' artificial natal release, and to reproduce their data drop the rows before it and condition on it. Only females ever seen with a pup are included, so survival to first pupping is 1 by construction. State letters resolved from the paper's natal sample sizes (header). Overlaps hastings_2018_forrester_philopatry_ms (the same deposit's Forrester Island analysis, at island scale, of females that pupped at F) and hastings_2018_seak_sealion_cjs (the same authors' survival deposit, dryad.541r5, whose branded pups include these females).
